name: Parallel API
description: Parallel Web Systems API — web search and research built for agents. POST /v1/search takes an objective plus keyword queries and returns ranked pages with compressed markdown excerpts. Its `mode` defaults to `advanced` when omitted, which is the slowest and most expensive preset (~3s, ~$5/1k) — pass `turbo` explicitly (~250ms, ~$1/1k) unless you need the extra quality; `fast` and `basic` sit in between. POST /v1/extract (GA, not /v1beta) returns full or targeted page content for a list of URLs. The Task API (POST /v1/tasks/runs, then GET /v1/tasks/runs/{run_id} and /result) runs async research tasks returning structured JSON with citations — note that POST /v1/tasks/runs answers 202 Accepted, not 200, so treat 202 as success. Auth is handled automatically via the PARALLEL_API_KEY environment variable, injected as the x-api-key header. The optional `parallel-beta` header gates specific opt-in features and is never required: it is accepted on some GA paths (e.g. /v1/tasks/runs) as well as on the deprecated /v1beta/findall/* endpoints. Pass it per-request when a feature calls for it — see the Parallel note in CONNECTIONS.md.

testConnection.description: Runs a minimal turbo-mode search to verify the Parallel API key
